items.body: Clubs began Mon 14 Sep and run Mon to Thu. Maximum two clubs per child. Club children are collected at 2:30 pm. No clubs on 22 Sep, 28 Sep or 29 Sep.
items.title: Term 1 Not-So-Boring Clubs

items.body: Tue 15 Sep, 2:30 pm, in the classroom. Open chance to ask general questions about routines and subjects. Message the class teacher to confirm. Not for one-to-one discussion of your child.
items.title: Year 5 coffee afternoon

items.body: 28 and 29 Sep. No after-school clubs on both days. Normal 1:30 pm dismissal from the Multipurpose Hall.
items.title: IB PYP verification visit

items.body: Families invited 12:30 to 2:00 pm in the Multipurpose Hall. Outfit of choice, nut-free treats welcome. Dismissal 1:30 pm if not attending.
items.title: Saudi National Day celebration

items.body: Ministry of Education guidance moved learning online for the day. On-campus classes resumed 28 Sep.
items.title: Campus closed, learning online

items.body: Light exercise session from the PE teacher and the Year 5 Spanish worksheet, shared for the online day.
items.title: PE and Spanish at home

items.body: Birthday celebrations now happen in the last lesson, 12:50 to 1:20 pm. Parents may cut the cake and take photos. Everything must finish by 1:20 pm because school buses leave at 1:25 pm.
items.title: Birthdays at Buckswood Riyadh

items.body: Students took part in a bullying awareness session led by a behaviour modification specialist, in collaboration with Vigour Locomotion Rehabilitation Center. It covered what bullying is, its effects, and treating others with empathy.
items.title: Bullying awareness session

items.body: Enrolled children got a confirmation announcement in Edunation. If you got none, your child is not in a Monday club and must be collected at 1:30 pm. Tuesday to Thursday confirmations followed.
items.title: Club enrolment confirmation, Mon 14 Sep

items.body: Registration for Term 1 Not-So-Boring Clubs opened through an online form. Places are first come, first served.
items.title: Term 1 clubs: registration open

items.body: Some clubs still had places. Each child may keep at most two clubs. To swap, say in the form Notes which choice to remove, otherwise one is removed at random.
items.title: Club registration reminder: limited spaces

items.body: Children not in clubs are collected at 1:30 pm. Club children at 2:30 pm sharp. A sibling not in a club must still leave at 1:30 pm. Staff cannot supervise late pick-ups after 2:30 pm.
items.title: Timely student collection

items.body: A welcome message to Buckswood families about greeting children at the gate each morning.
items.title: A message from Dr. T

items.body: EduPik is a new dismissal feature in the Edunation app, trialled from the week of 20 Sep. Send the pickup request in the app between 1:20 and 1:45 pm. Dismissal starts 1:30 pm from the Multipurpose Hall. Keep the Edunation app installed and updated. Parent guides (English and Arabic) were attached to the email.
items.title: EduPik dismissal system: parent information

items.body: EduPik started 20 Sep. Have the Edunation app downloaded, updated and working before collection time. EduPik is open 1:20 to 1:45 pm, dismissal begins 1:30 pm at the Multipurpose Hall. Contact the school if the app gives trouble.
items.title: Reminder: EduPik dismissal system starts today

items.body: A brochure about the importance of personal hygiene for children was shared.
items.title: Personal hygiene awareness

items.body: IB verification team visits 28 and 29 Sep. No after-school clubs on those days, school day and 1:30 pm dismissal unchanged.
items.title: IB PYP verification visit and club update

items.body: Strict no-jewelry rule for all grades, for safety and safeguarding. Exceptions: a simple watch and one pair of small plain studs for girls with pierced ears.
items.title: No jewelry policy

items.body: A library book and card came home. Return the book by Sunday and enjoy quiet reading time before then.
items.title: Year 5 parents: library book and card

items.body: Tue 22 Sep, 12:30 to 2:00 pm, Multipurpose Hall. Attending parents collect their child from the homeroom teacher after performances. Others: dismissal 1:30 pm. Thu 24 Sep is a normal school day.
items.title: Saudi National Day celebration and arrangements

items.body: Tue 22 Sep was a normal school day. Parents invited 12:30 to 2:00 pm for refreshments and to meet homeroom and subject teachers. Dress code: green and white. No clubs that day. Buses ran as usual.
items.title: Saudi National Day celebration, 22 Sep

items.body: Strict nut-free rule: no peanuts, tree nuts, nut butters or spreads in lunchboxes, because some students and staff have severe allergies. From the Designated Safeguarding Lead and Head of Pastoral Care.
items.title: Nut-free school policy

items.body: Campuses closed on Ministry guidance. Teachers shared handouts in the morning, official online classes started the next day.
items.title: Online learning arrangements

items.body: School back on campus 28 Sep. Arrive on time, return textbooks and handouts, buses run as normal, no clubs due to the IB visit.
items.title: Regular on-campus classes resume

items.body: Dismissal 1:30 pm from the Multipurpose Hall (EduPik pickup window 1:20 to 1:45 pm). Club pick-up 2:30 pm. Birthday celebrations 12:50 to 1:20 pm. Buses leave from 1:25 pm. Nut-free school. No jewelry except a simple watch and small plain studs.

items.title: How Buckswood recruits, welcomes and develops its team

items.body: Settling in and building friendships. Maths: Place Value unit. Reading: finding each child's level. Unit of Inquiry: Who We Are (culture, values, families, communities). Thanks to parents who contributed to the class Padlet.

items.body: English: biographies and autobiographies, key features and pair work. Maths: numbers in standard, word and expanded form, plus a Saudi Arabia shape project with number facts. Science: seedlings and how plants begin to grow. Drama: Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech and rights and responsibilities. A new student was named Student of the Week.

Science: pollination, seedlings and early plant growth.
